For the treatment of HIV infec- tion in children, ritonavir is given daily with other antiretroviral drugs. US licensed product information permits the use of oral ritonavir in infants over 1 month of age, whereas in the UK it is recommended from 2 years of age. The dose given should not exceed the maximum adult dose of 600 mg twice daily. The recommended dose regimen is an initial dose of 250 mg/m2 twice daily increasing by 50 mg/m2 twice daily at 2- or 3-day intervals up to 350 to 400 mg/m2 twice daily. Molluscum contagiosum.
